card.name: Linking words before viral or contraceptive terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, by, an, from, of, contain) and section digits just before a noun such as virus, inactivation, or oral contraceptive. Seen in blood-product safety text, contraceptive interaction text, and highlight-section numbers.

modes.label: Linking word before virus terms
modes.description: A short word like by, from or of right before viral screening or inactivation wording.

modes.label: Word before oral contraceptive
modes.description: An article or verb leading into oral contraceptive drug-interaction wording.
modes.example: Single doses of<< an>> oral contraceptive tablet containing levonorgest

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: The digit 5 in a cross-reference like (5.8) in a warnings highlights list.
modes.example: Transmission of infectious agents from human plasma ( <<5>>.8 )

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens and the contexts; the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before talk of viruses or oral contraceptives in drug labels.
